name: slouch_bench
text: A person rests on a park bench with their torso gently reclined backward. Both hands rest loosely on the upper thighs in the lap, forearms in front of the torso. Both feet stay on the floor in front of the seat. Stay in this comfortable relaxed seated pose with subtle breathing and small natural balance adjustments.
